subject: Re: Status: retrieval ablations - the delta is real but small
body:
Quentin, Jelena,

Decision after portfolio review: we reframe the Aug 14 readout around factual consistency, not answer quality. The 31% reduction in unsupported claims is the number leadership cares about - it maps directly to the grounded-answers product thesis and the "massive financial implications" framing survives contact with an exec audience in a way +1.4 ROUGE-L does not.

Concretely: Quentin and Wei build out the claim-verification eval as the primary metric; the ROUGE table moves to an appendix. Saoirse, please make sure the harness can re-run the 200-example audit at 1,000 examples so the headline isn't resting on a small n.

We are NOT committing to a productization go at the readout - the ask will be a Q4 incubation slot with a proper retriever refresh. Jelena, sanity-check that team shape holds through Aug 17.

Anders
